per_finding_diagram_type.description: Diagram shape best fitting THIS finding's code path. flowchart: the data/control path that reaches the bug. sequence: a cross-service/actor call ordering where the issue lives. before_after: when the finding is about a behavior delta. state: when a wrong/missing status transition is the issue. Required whenever per_finding_mermaid is set.

per_finding_mermaid.description:
Valid mermaid of the declared per_finding_diagram_type (flowchart->'flowchart', before_after->'flowchart', sequence->'sequenceDiagram', state->'stateDiagram-v2'). Shows the SPECIFIC code path this finding is about and HIGHLIGHTS the problematic node. NO fences. ALL node labels double-quoted (A["..."], C{"..."}); NEVER backslash-escape brackets (\[ \] — backslash is not an escape character in mermaid); use
for line breaks. Inside a label write a double quote as #quot; (' only if a single quote is what you meant), and a literal angle bracket as #lt; / #gt; — those are mermaid's own escapes, and a bare is read as an HTML tag and disappears from the rendering. NEVER HTML entities (" < >) — nothing normalizes this diagram before it is written out. Concrete sample data ONLY on the 1-2 edges central to the failure, not every edge. Mark the failing node: flowchart/before_after/state add `classDef problem fill:#ffb3b3,stroke:#c00` and tag it `:::problem`; sequence wrap the bad message in a `rect` or `Note over X: bug`. Keep it focused: ~4-8 nodes. Required for mitigated/blocker by simo-dev:mr-review step 5 validation, optional for resolved.
